profile.description: Knowledge Economic City Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development of real estate, economic cities, and other development projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Real Estate Development and Investment segments. It undertakes infrastructure, telecommunication networks, electricity plants, and water treatment plants, as well as other works related to developing economic cities. The company also owns the land parcel; and is involved in investing activities. Knowledge Economic City Company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Al Madinah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
